fieldDefinitions.name: Show ingredient promise button
fieldDefinitions.description: Turn off to hide the button.

fieldDefinitions.name: Button text
fieldDefinitions.description: Leave empty to use the original website wording.

fieldDefinitions.name: Button link
fieldDefinitions.description: Use a website path such as /our-story or a full https:// address.

fieldDefinitions.name: Show botanical decoration
fieldDefinitions.description: Turn off to hide both decorative botanical illustrations.

fieldDefinitions.name: Photo transition pace
fieldDefinitions.description: 2 = current slow animation. 1 = faster; 4 = slowest. Does not change the six-second slideshow interval.

fieldDefinitions.name: Paper background color
fieldDefinitions.description: Used behind background images and for the caption card. Clear background images to see a solid section color.

fieldDefinitions.name: Text color
fieldDefinitions.description: Choose the section color.

fieldDefinitions.name: Accent and desktop button color
fieldDefinitions.description: Choose the section color.

fieldDefinitions.name: Phone arch background color
fieldDefinitions.description: Choose the section color.

fieldDefinitions.name: Phone arch text color
fieldDefinitions.description: Choose the section color.

fieldDefinitions.name: gooey effect
fieldDefinitions.description: Reveal the next image through a liquid mask around the cursor. Uses a simple image transition when animations are disabled or WebGL is unavailable.

fieldDefinitions.name: Automatically change posters
fieldDefinitions.description: Rotate only the three poster galleries. All headings, titles and descriptions stay fixed. Pauses on hover, keyboard focus, or a background tab.

fieldDefinitions.name: image duration (seconds)
fieldDefinitions.description: Time each poster stays visible before changing. Recommended: 6 seconds.

fieldDefinitions.name: gooey strength
fieldDefinitions.description: 0.5 = subtle, 1 = recommended, 1.5 = stronger liquid distortion. Global motion settings and visitor reduced-motion preferences take priority.

fieldDefinitions.name: Shery preset (JSON)
fieldDefinitions.description: Paste the complete JSON from Shery Debug Panel > Save To Clipboard. Leave {} to use the default gooey settings. Image order and slideshow timing are managed in their existing fields.
